evaluateDatasetTrustDecision blocks agent use when no agent-use policy is attached, when ladder state is only available, or when ladder state is only loaded.
Every decision carries createdFrom 'deterministic_dataset_trust_seed'; permitted decisions carry an empty reasons list; blocked decisions carry a non-empty reasons list.
